question: What position does the goddess hold amid divine pride and as support of the supreme deity?
premises: The goddess stands in the midst of the pride of the deities.
The goddess is identified as the bow or support of the deity of deities.
inference: She occupies a central, empowering position within the divine hierarchy.
uncertainties: devatādevatādanuḥ is obscure; interpreted as bow/support of the deity of deities based on token form.
